headline: Four -100% price gaps and an 11.6σ volume spike on SQ dominate a busy morning across coverage.
market_take: Coverage breadth is heavy on alerts (46) with the standout extremes being ZEN, TLHPF and MNIT opening at -100.00% gaps and SQ printing an 11.6σ volume spike. PF&REIT and PROP names show the most divergent single-day moves (KC +50.00% vol×0.0 vs PF -20.00%). Several alerts tie directly to fresh filings: TPOLY's director resignation lines up with its volume spike and intraday +11.11%, TTLPF's high-impact capital reduction follows consecutive capital-reduction filings, and JCK's triple-alert day (5.1σ volume, -8.33% gap, +27.27% intraday) closes at +16.67%. Management turnover at TPIPL, MADAME and OSP also warrants monitoring.
